newsitem.title: CANADA: Four Seasons to sell 3.8 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Four Seasons to sell 3.8 million shares.

text.p: Four Seasons Hotels Inc said on Friday underwriters agreed to acquire 3.8 million limited voting shares of Four Seasons for US$20.75 per share, for estimated net proceeds of US$75 million.
Four Seasons said the underwriters have an over-allotment option to acquire up to an additional 570,000 limited voting shares at US$20.75 per share.

The luxury hotel and resort manager said it will use about US$37 million of the proceeds to reduce existing bank indebtedness and about US$25 million to fund a loan to be made by Four Seasons when it acquires the long-term management agreement for the Hotel George V in Paris. The balance of proceeds will be used to provide liquidity to fund expansion and for general captial purposes.
In connection with the offering, the limitied voting shares were approved for listing on the New York Stock Exchange, subject to official notice of issuance, Four Seasons said.
